findings.finding: The evidence-backed semantic core survived one materially different cross-language bounded realization without requiring the current Event/reducer/Receipt/SQL representation.
findings.architectural_effect: Retain the provisional meaning-level obligations, but state support as BPV1-scoped rather than substrate-universal.

findings.finding: Identity and continuation across an actual representation migration remain unadjudicated.
findings.architectural_effect: Do not claim that cross-representation migration preserves semantic identity until a dedicated migration scenario is preregistered and executed.

findings.finding: Physical and cryptographic erasure claims remain outside BPV1-001 and therefore cannot be strengthened by D5/D6.
findings.architectural_effect: Keep physical and cryptographic erasure separately scoped and evidence-dependent; logical loss/compaction remains insufficient evidence.

findings.finding: Analog, neuromorphic and probabilistic computation classes remain untested.
findings.architectural_effect: Future-substrate language must remain hypothesis-level; BPV1-001 is conventional digital evidence only.

findings.finding: Storage and computation independence were not isolated as independent experimental axes.
findings.architectural_effect: Do not infer independent storage/computation substitutability from a run that changed several mechanisms together.

findings.finding: The laboratory-versus-Canon governance boundary remains operationally preserved, but BPV1-001 did not adjudicate A10-H11 as an experimental target.
findings.architectural_effect: Preserve prior governance evidence without relabelling it as BPV1 substrate evidence.

findings.finding: A10-H07 is strengthened only to one same-repository Rust realization on a conventional digital computation model; independent implementation team, custody and computation model remain unestablished.
findings.architectural_effect: Do not describe BPV1-001 as independent implementation validation or universal portability proof; independent team, custody and computation-model validation remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.

findings.finding: Composition and federation remain a separate capability class outside the single-node BPV1-001 scope.
basis: IAR-1-R1 local conformance does not imply composition conformance
findings.architectural_effect: No local conformance result may be promoted to federated/composed conformance.

findings.finding: Neither D5 nor D6 creates automatic Canon or runtime authority.
findings.architectural_effect: P1-C5 remains a bounded reference laboratory and the Rust subject remains a falsification instrument only.

findings.finding: The strongest defensible substrate-independence statement after BPV1-001 is that selected semantic obligations survived one materially different bounded conventional-digital realization under a frozen external evaluation protocol.
findings.architectural_effect: Use this scoped statement in D8 synchronization; reject wording that implies arbitrary future-substrate support.
